nodes.rationale: Ship Home and About with shared identity, navigation and contact areas.

nodes.label: Deferred Projects navigation
nodes.source_location: ## Projects before the Projects page exists
nodes.rationale: Projects page is not designed; keep project navigation, View All, controls and previews static.

nodes.label: Explicit pen.dev page sync
nodes.rationale: pen.dev governs visual intent and visible copy; repository holds responsive and accessible implementation. Sync an affected page when Alan requests it.

nodes.label: Legacy Alan character reuse
nodes.rationale: Reuse greeting, wave, eight-direction head assets and accessible alternatives without a new animation library.

nodes.label: Deferred GitHub connection and hosting
nodes.rationale: Review a local working preview before GitHub connection, public hosting or ongoing spending decisions.

nodes.label: pen.dev FIX design frames
nodes.description: ZzLQS Home; XElO4 About; YdTwg Shelf interaction reference, not a third page.

nodes.label: Shared Contact modal
nodes.rationale: Sidebar and page CTAs open one modal with immediate actions, focus containment, scroll locking and restoration.

nodes.label: Magnetic contact controls
nodes.rationale: Keep fixed hit targets and immediate modal action while separate liquid surfaces move; touch and reduced motion retain feedback.

nodes.label: Native browser cursor
nodes.rationale: Alan removed sticky cursor on 2026-10-26; preserve magnetic/gooey controls without cursor overlays or cursor hiding.

nodes.label: Personal portrait print reveal
nodes.rationale: Rotate entire print -2 degrees with fixed crop and layout, an interruptible 0.16-second critical spring and keyboard/touch alternatives.

nodes.label: Blob buddy spring states
nodes.rationale: Use anchored artwork, bounded pointer response, lively idle motion and squish/rebound retaining velocity across interruption.

nodes.label: Shelf quote bubbles
nodes.rationale: Approved pale-blue speech bubbles replace dark cards and accent rules; exact content and input behavior remain authoritative.

nodes.label: Reduced-motion alternatives
nodes.rationale: Remove quote entrance transforms and pointer following; anchor quote and tail to artwork including live preference changes.

nodes.label: Decorative motion suspension
nodes.rationale: Pause movement and tracking offscreen, in hidden tabs and behind Contact modal.

nodes.label: Viewport-safe quote portal
nodes.rationale: Render outside Shelf scroller, reserve tail space, fit within 24px gutters and flip; compact type at heights of 400px or less.

nodes.label: Light-mode responsive adaptation
nodes.rationale: Compact identity/menu, smaller character, fitting project grid and contained horizontal Shelf scroller.

nodes.label: Home and About visual system
nodes.rationale: White canvas, dark text, restrained cobalt, image-led content, Geist interface and Caveat personal notes.

nodes.label: Shared pale-blue surface
nodes.rationale: Existing blue-surface token fills contact panel, selection and Shelf quote bubbles.

nodes.label: Responsive shell
nodes.rationale: 1440px maximum shell, 248px sidebar, 64px gap; single column at 1000px and below.

nodes.label: Shelf speech-bubble treatment
nodes.rationale: Scoped pale-blue bubble extension approved 2026-10-26; preserve exact quotes and accessible input behavior.

nodes.label: Portrait print treatment
nodes.rationale: Fixed anchor and proportional crop protect layout and source proportions while print, paper and caption reveal.

nodes.label: Magnetic liquid contact surfaces
nodes.rationale: Separate unfiltered icon layer stays crisp while liquid silhouette follows spring motion.

nodes.label: Native pointer requirement
nodes.rationale: Sticky cursor removed 2026-10-26; retain native browser cursor.

nodes.label: Viewport-fitted quote and tail
nodes.rationale: Fixed portal escapes Shelf overflow, fits 24px gutters, reserves 14px tail space and respects visual viewport.

nodes.label: Soft Shelf speech bubbles
nodes.rationale: Quotes feel like Shelf speaking through bubbles related to Blob buddy; replace rejected dark cards and accent lines.

nodes.label: Readable quotes and attribution
nodes.rationale: Keep quote, attribution and curved tail within narrow and short viewports, with keyboard/touch dismissal and static reduced motion.

nodes.label: Soft Shelf speech bubbles
nodes.rationale: Quotes feel like Shelf speaking through bubbles related to Blob buddy; replace rejected dark cards and accent lines.

nodes.label: Readable quotes and attribution
nodes.rationale: Keep quote, attribution and curved tail within narrow and short viewports, with keyboard/touch dismissal and static reduced motion.

nodes.label: Verified first implementation milestone
nodes.rationale: Home and About, responsive states, contact destinations, character/Blob/Shelf interactions and local preview verified 2026-10-24.

nodes.label: Build and browser verification
nodes.rationale: Production build and TypeScript passed, both pages statically prerendered; initial ten Playwright checks covered responsive layout and accessible interactions.

nodes.label: Magnetic contact controls update
nodes.rationale: New arrow interaction checks plus existing contact, layout, Shelf, Blob and character checks passed; fixed target and immediate action retained.

nodes.label: Sticky cursor removal
nodes.source_location: ## Sticky cursor and magnetic pill update, 2026-10-26
nodes.rationale: Sticky cursor component, overlay, registration and cursor hiding removed; magnetic/gooey pill and arrows remain. Earlier cursor validation is historical.

nodes.label: Portrait print update
nodes.rationale: Verified -2 degree print rotation, proportional crop, fixed hit area, caption clearance, rapid reversals, input alternatives and live reduced-motion changes.

nodes.label: Blob motion update
nodes.rationale: Expanded idle drift, breathing, skew, glances, double blinks and spring wobble retain interruption and visibility/modal suspension.

nodes.label: Shelf quote bubble update
nodes.rationale: Eleven checks passed initially; four affected Shelf/input checks rerun after reduced-motion anchoring correction; final production build passed.

nodes.label: Recorded incumbent design system
nodes.rationale: Root DESIGN.md and .impeccable/design.json record existing system and scoped extension; no shipping raster additions.

nodes.label: Faiz Intifada reference review
nodes.rationale: Desktop reference and Alan local pages inspected; mobile capture reused, not a fresh mobile session. Recommendations are proposals, not approved implementation.

nodes.label: Proposed larger project presentation
nodes.source_location: ### 1. Make selected work the main visual attraction
nodes.rationale: Try 3:2 or 16:10 framing, legible interface detail, consistent margins and useful role/context captions without inventing outcomes.

nodes.label: Proposed compact header and centered content
nodes.source_location: ### 2. Reduce the desktop sidebar's visual weight
nodes.rationale: Compare compact header/centered content with slimmer sidebar; retain character and Blob behavior.

nodes.label: Proposed earlier CADIT context
nodes.source_location: ### 3. Introduce Alan and his work earlier
nodes.rationale: State product-design role, Bandung location and CADIT component-library/client responsibilities earlier.

nodes.label: Proposed common section alignment
nodes.rationale: Share alignment across labels, prose, grids and footer; let selected visuals expand deliberately.

nodes.label: Preserved personal identity elements
nodes.source_location: ### 5. Keep personal details and give each a clear role
nodes.rationale: Work dominates Home; story, portrait and Shelf carry About; Blob stays small and character avoids delaying mobile work.

nodes.label: Proposed authentic design proof
nodes.source_location: ### 6. Add proof that fits a product designer
nodes.rationale: Prioritize strong case studies, actual CADIT experience, design-system examples and authentic collaborator quotes.

nodes.label: Layout refinement before further motion
nodes.rationale: Current custom interactions already substantial; preserve accessible motion and establish composition before adding reveals.
